# openinfra_graphql_api (Resource)

A neutral GraphQL API served by the open-appsync engine: a schema plus data sources and resolvers, each resolver declaring a `runtime` (today `appsync-vtl`) and carrying its request/response mapping templates inline. A team's existing AppSync VTL runs byte-for-byte unchanged. Compiles to an engine Deployment + Service (EXPERIMENTAL).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `resolvers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolvers))

### Optional

- `api_keys_secret` (String) Name of a Secret (in this API's namespace) holding `apikeys.json` — a JSON array of `{key, username, groups}`. Enables `@aws_api_key` auth. THE KEY IS AN IDENTITY: presenting a key authenticates the request AS the mapped k8s identity (username/groups), whose SubjectAccessReview then authorizes `@aws_api_key` fields — the same one policy world as every other front door. Keep key material in this Secret, never in the spec. `@aws_iam`/`@aws_oidc`/`@aws_cognito_user_pools` are likewise enforced when their directives appear; `@aws_lambda` is advisory (reported, not enforced).
- `data_sources` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_sources))
- `image` (String) The open-appsync engine image serving this API.
- `limits` (Attributes) Hostile-load guards; ON by default even if omitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `mongo_db` (String) FerretDB database name for `dynamodb` data sources.
- `mongo_uri` (String) FerretDB (Mongo wire) endpoint backing `dynamodb` data sources. Required only if a data source is `dynamodb`; a `dynamodb` source with no `mongo_uri` fails closed at load.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `replicas` (Number)
- `schema` (String) GraphQL SDL for the API. When set, the engine parses it into an in-memory type graph and answers `__schema`/`__type` introspection over it, so GraphQL tooling can build a client schema. Optional: the executor still resolves fields from the resolver list without it, but introspection is then unavailable.
- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) Subscription-type fields (experimental; served over graphql-transport-ws). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
- `url` (String) In-cluster GraphQL endpoint of the engine.

<a id="nestedatt--resolvers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resolvers`

Required:

- `field` (String) The GraphQL field name, e.g. `getTodo`.
- `type` (String) `Query` or `Mutation`.

Optional:

- `after` (String) Pipeline: after mapping template (shapes the final value from `$ctx.prev.result`).
- `auth` (Attributes) The RBAC permission the caller must have to resolve this field. Omit for a public field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolvers--auth))
- `before` (String) Pipeline: before mapping template (sets `$ctx.stash` / may abort; no data source).
- `data_source` (String) Unit resolver: name of a `data_sources` entry.
- `functions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resolvers--functions))
- `request` (String) Unit resolver: request mapping template (VTL), or the full JS module for `appsync-js`.
- `response` (String) Unit resolver: response mapping template source.
- `runtime` (String) The resolver runtime: `appsync-vtl` (default) or `appsync-js` (a sandboxed JS module in `request`).

<a id="nestedatt--resolvers--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resolvers.auth`

Optional:

- `group` (String) API group, e.g. `openinfra.dev`.
- `name` (String) Optional specific object name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace, or empty for cluster-scoped.
- `resource` (String) Resource plural, e.g. `graphqlapis`.
- `verb` (String) e.g. `get`, `create`.


<a id="nestedatt--resolvers--functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resolvers.functions`

Required:

- `data_source` (String) Name of a `data_sources` entry this function targets.
- `request` (String) The function's request mapping template.
- `response` (String) The function's response mapping template.

Optional:

- `runtime` (String) Defaults to `appsync-vtl`.



<a id="nestedatt--data_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_sources`

Required:

- `name` (String) Data source name a resolver references.

Optional:

- `collection` (String) `dynamodb`: the FerretDB collection (the 'table').
- `connection_secret` (String) Name of a Secret (this API's namespace) holding this source's credentials, kept out of the spec. `rds`: a `dsn` key with the PostgreSQL connection string. `opensearch`: optional `username`/`password` keys for HTTP basic auth.
- `endpoint` (String) `http`: the base URL the resolver's operation targets. `lambda`: the function (`kind: Function`) URL. `opensearch`: the domain endpoint. `eventbridge`: an optional NATS URL (defaults to the platform NATS bus).
- `type` (String) `memory` (default, ephemeral), `none` (no backend — resolved in the mapping templates, for pub/sub-only fields and local computation), `dynamodb` (FerretDB-backed), `http` (an HTTP endpoint), `lambda` (invoke a `kind: Function` over HTTP), `rds` (SQL over PostgreSQL/Aurora-PostgreSQL, DSN in `connection_secret`), `opensearch` (search against an OpenSearch domain), or `eventbridge` (publish events to the NATS event bus).


<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Optional:

- `introspection` (String) Who may read the schema via `__schema`/`__type`: `enabled` (default, any client — best for tooling), `disabled` (never), or `authenticated-only` (off for anonymous callers). Requires `schema`.
- `max_cost` (Number) Reject queries with more fields than this (default 1000; negative disables).
- `max_depth` (Number) Reject queries nested past this (default 10; negative disables).
- `persisted_only` (Boolean) Only pre-registered documents in `persisted_queries` run.
- `persisted_queries` (List of String) Allow-listed query documents (for `persisted_only`).


<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Required:

- `field` (String) The Subscription field name, e.g. `onCreateTodo`.
- `response` (String) Response mapping that shapes each pushed event.

Optional:

- `auth` (Attributes) Authorization checked at subscribe time (a SubjectAccessReview). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions--auth))
- `runtime` (String) Defaults to `appsync-vtl`.
- `subject` (String) Bus subject; defaults to `sub.<field>`.
- `triggered_by` (List of String) Mutation field names whose success publishes to this subscription.

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.auth`

Optional:

- `group` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `resource` (String)
- `verb` (String)
